title: feat(showcase): demonstrate RLS check (D4) + compound sharing (#1887) as live examples
body:
Shows the two new authz capabilities on the **real showcase app** so AI authors see them in use (the showcase is living documentation).

## What
- **RLS `check` (ADR-0058 D4)**: `invoice_owner_immutable` on showcase_invoice — a contributor cannot reassign an invoice they own to a different owner (write-time post-image validation, not a read filter).
- **Compound sharing (ADR-0058 D3 / #1887)**: `HighValueRedProjectRule` with `record.health == 'red' && record.budget > 100000` — before #1887 a compound `&&` condition was silently skipped; now it compiles to a compound criteria_json and enforces (the AND matters).

## Proof (dogfood: showcase-d3-d4-capabilities)
- the compound condition seeds as `{$and:[{health:'red'},{budget:{$gt:100000}}]}` and matches **only** the red-AND-high project (not red-but-cheap, not high-but-green);
- the RLS check **denies** an owner reassignment over HTTP and **allows** a same-owner edit.

Full dogfood **141** (26 files), no regression. example/dogfood are private → no changeset.
